Hi Sienna — thank you, I received both documents and uploaded them to the intake folder.

Next steps from procurement side (summary):
1) Please complete our vendor intake form (link below) so we have the legal remit email and AP contact. That populates our vendor profile and PO routing fields.
   - Vendor intake form: https://drive.redwood.com/forms/vendor-intake-acme-2027
2) For payment setup we need either a bank letter (you attached one, good) or a successful ACH micro-deposit. If you prefer ACH, we will trigger a two-micro-deposit test to the account on file — finance will reach out with exact amounts.
3) PO processing: we require an acceptance confirmation. A signed DocuSign is preferred for new vendors for contract tracking, but an explicit acceptance email referencing PO-00123 will work for Net 30 terms.
4) Remittance format: please use the PO number in the invoice subject and include your internal invoice number after the prefix "ACME_INV" (example: ACME_INV-2027-089). This helps our AP auto-apply.

I copied Jonas from Finance to confirm the vendor code and create the PO entry. Marissa, can you review the PO acceptance/DocuSign step?
